description: DevSarathi status: graph age, baseline commit, branch drift, pending rule changes
body: Run `devsarathi status --json` and summarize it in two or three lines. Mention anything stale, disabled or pending.

description: Impact lookup before editing a symbol or file
body: Run `devsarathi impact $ARGUMENTS --json`. Present callers, couplings, tests covering it, the confidence grade and every reason. The list may be incomplete for dynamic patterns; say so.

description: Full review of the current changes: security, impact, tests and spec. Same command the pre-push hook runs
body: Run `devsarathi review --json`. Print the numbered findings, red flags first. If any agent run shows status other than `completed`, print `<agent> did not run: <error>`; that is never a clean review. Then, acting as `ds-peer-review`, check each caller listed under untouched callers and add comments. Do not change code.

description: Run the tester: tests exist for changed logic, run them, map to acceptance criteria
body: Delegate to the `ds-tester` agent. It runs `devsarathi test --json` and reports pass, fail or incomplete. Never report a pass for a run that did not complete.

description: Turn a short request plus the spec or Jira ticket into an accurate, ordered prompt
body: Run `devsarathi enhance $ARGUMENTS --json`. If it lists problems with the spec, show them and stop for the developer; never fill the gaps. If a Jira ticket could not be fetched, ask for a paste and pass it with `--paste`. Otherwise show the enhanced prompt as a preview and ask the developer to accept, edit or reject it, then record the answer with `devsarathi enhance --outcome accepted|edited|rejected` and carry out the accepted prompt.

description: Incrementally refresh the graph and propose rule updates
body: Run `devsarathi refresh`. Summarize what changed and list any rule changes waiting for approval (`/ds-rules pending`).

description: Build the Drishti graph (baseline by default)
body: Run `devsarathi graph build $ARGUMENTS`. A build can take minutes on a large repo; it runs in the background elsewhere and is safe to leave.

description: List and decide pending rule changes
body: Run `devsarathi rules $ARGUMENTS`. Present each pending change with its reason and risk; the developer approves or rejects. Do not approve on their behalf.

description: Show local metrics and regenerate the reports
body: Run `devsarathi metrics $ARGUMENTS` and summarize turns per task (before versus after) together with the acceptance rate.
Run `devsarathi dashboard`. It serves on 127.0.0.1 only.
Run `devsarathi selftest` and report each check. A failure must be shown with its details.

description: Optional: research and install Claude skills for this stack
body: Run `devsarathi skills`. It shows the exact summary payload before anything is sent, and installs only ticked items.

description: Bring generated files up to the installed DevSarathi version
body: Run `devsarathi migrate` and show the diff. Files the developer edited are never overwritten.

description: Kill switch: turn off all DevSarathi hooks and automatic behavior
Turn DevSarathi hooks and automatic behavior back on
